fixes.problem: The card background is a flat navy, but the real one is a translucent starfield. The golden checkmark badge is a flat yellow check, but the real one is a gold seal.
fixes.fix: Make the card fill rgba(20,30,90,0.35) with a 1px border of rgba(255,255,255,0.15). Draw the badge as a gold seal shape (#d9a520) with a lighter check. Move all text up 1px.

fixes.problem: The tag emojis differ from the real ones: the 👨 Male, 👤 AnyPOV, 📺 Anime and 🛸 Sci-Fi glyphs render as different emoji. The heading text sits about 1px too high.
fixes.fix: Use the same emoji glyphs as the real screen at 11px, and shift the heading and chip text down 1px. The chips and the pager buttons have a slightly different border radius, so match them (pager buttons 8px radius).

fixes.problem: The chat titles sit about 1px too high and render slightly bolder and wider. The star glyph is bigger. Truncation shows 'New Empl…' where the real one shows 'New Emplo…'.
fixes.fix: Set the title font-weight to 500, the size to 16px, and the letter-spacing to 0. Shift the titles down 1px and shrink the star to match. The header title is 1px too high, so move it down 1px.

fixes.problem: The gear icon is a filled cog but the real one is an outline gear. The bottom-nav center icon is a flat gray cat, but the real one is a spiral logo. The title is bolder and 1px too high.
fixes.fix: Draw the gear with a 1.8px stroke, no fill, 18px in size. Draw the nav center icon as a gray (#8a8a8a) spiral cat logo. Set the title font-weight to 500 and move it down 1px.

fixes.problem: The bottom nav center icon is a cat face but the real one is a purple spiral logo.

summary: All tagged elements and taps already land, so the remaining gap is visual fidelity. This round should fix the art placement on s15 and rebuild the s17 nebula background and logo. It should also fix the text weights, 1px offsets and icons on s03 and s04.
